data: What is the value of the constraint violation error of TWID for the orange line at the 1st iteration?

The question asks for the value of the constraint violation error of TWID for the orange line at the 1st iteration. From the caption, we know that the orange line corresponds to T = 0.03. In the right graph, the y-axis represents the constraint violation error of TWID on a logarithmic scale. At the 1st iteration (x=1), the orange line intersects the y-axis at approximately 10^-1. Therefore, the value of the constraint violation error of TWID for the orange line at the 1st iteration is around 0.1.
